items.title: Do Wall Street Analysts Like SBA Communications Stock?
items.summary: SBA Communications has underperformed the broader market over the past year, but analysts are cautiously optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: $2 Billion Refinance Could Reshape The Case For SBA Communications Stock (SBAC)
items.summary: SBA Communications entered into a new senior unsecured term loan credit agreement providing US$2.0b of term loans that mature in November 2029. This includes US$1.165b funded at closing and US$835m of delayed draw commitments, with interest tied to SOFR or a base rate and subject to ratings-based margins. items.title: 3 Cell Tower REITs Positioned to Profit as Wireless Data Demand Quadruples
items.summary: One tower REIT slashed its dividend last year, another has raised its payout every year since 2019, and a third yields the most with the least cushion. Which one deserves your income dollars before the next spectrum auction?

items.title: 5 Dividend Stocks With Ex-Dividend Deadlines This Week. The First Is Today
items.summary: One utility's payout window slams shut at today's closing bell, and four more follow before Friday. Each dividend carries a hidden catch, from heavy debt to a payout frozen since 2020, so the yield alone won't tell you which are safe.

items.title: SBA Communications (SBAC) Stock May Be 32% Below Fair Value As Q3 Outlook Improves
items.summary: SBA Communications has bounced recently, yet over a longer stretch its shareholders have seen a sizable pullback, which puts the focus squarely on whether the current US$195.48 share price lines up with the cash the business can generate. With that mixed share performance and an active capital return program, the key issue is how much of the recent move is grounded in the underlying cash flows rather than shifting sentiment. items.title: Why SBA Communications Stock Is Up 5.8% And What's Next
items.summary: SBA Communications reported third quarter 2026 results with US$713.92 million in revenue, US$231.31 million in net income and US$3.19 FFO per share, and affirmed a US$1.25 quarterly dividend alongside updated full year revenue guidance of US$2.833 billion to US$2.858 billion. items.title: Crown Castle Soars 6% as SpaceX Taps Qualcomm for a “Credible Fourth” Mobile Network
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrown Castle stock rose 6% today after SpaceX picked Qualcomm to supply base stations for Starlink Mobile’s US 5G network, starting in 2027. Starlink Mobile will need towers, and a fourth carrier could fill the hole DISH left in Crown Castle’s leasing.

items.title: Wireless Data Demand Is Surging. Why Did Crown Castle Cut Its Dividend 32%?
items.summary: Americans are consuming wireless data at a record pace, yet one of the biggest tower landlords just slashed its dividend by nearly a third. Understanding which tower REITs can still grow their payouts requires a close look at what separates a safe yield from a trap.
